name: Vestor
description: Chrome extension that allows quick switching between tabs by saving them when the user requests. The user can then request up to the first 4 saved tabs to make them active. Similar to harpoon in neovim

add-to-harpoon.description: Adds the current tab to the harpoon

remove-from-harpoon.description: Removes the current tab from harpoon if harpoon of the current window contains it

harpoon-1.description: Goes to the first harpoon tab

harpoon-2.description: Goes to the second harpoon tab

harpoon-3.description: Goes to the third harpoon tab

harpoon-4.description: Goes to the fourth harpoon tab

debug.description: Shows the current tabs in harpoon in the service worker console.
